about: The air and what floats in it (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Air and lift'). 'scaleHeight': metres over which the air thins by e above 'seaLevel'. 'lift': kg a cubic metre at sea level, per gas ('hotAir' at a full cell's heat). 'gasLitresPerM3': litres of a tank's compressed gas that fill a cubic metre of cell. Soft lift, the kinder scale of big builds: a construct's lift counts (cell volume / softFromM3) ^ softPower times over, from softFromM3 up, at most softMost. 'leakSpeed': m/s gas leaves through a hole. 'holePerDamage': m2 of hole a point of damage makes, at most 'holeMost' m2 a hit and 'holeCell' m2 a cell; a hit of 'igniteDamage' or more lights hydrogen. 'coolShare', 'ventShare', 'ventHotShare', 'pumpShare', 'burnShare': shares of a cell a second. 'drag': the cell's drag coefficient, acting 'dragArm' of the way from the centre of mass to the centre of lift. 'spinDrag': how fast air stops a balloon's turning, a second at sea level. 'turbulence': m/s2 of shake for each m/s of wind. 'windAloftAt': metres up where the cloud-level wind has taken over. 'nearMetres': cells this close to a player are simulated one by one; further off, lift is one summed force. 'groundEffect' and 'groundEffectSpans': the hook for wings: lift gained at the ground, and how many spans up it fades.
